messages:
Lena P: Heads-up: vendors adjusted delivery windows for H100/H200 and MI300. Need quick consensus on marketplace announce strategy this sprint.
Arjun S: Which SKUs moved and by how much? Any embargo blockers?
NVIDIA - Mei: H200 allocation delayed ~9 days in NA region. APAC unaffected so far. We can still do a joint announcement if copy uses a soft availability window. Partners want a 48h pre-brief.
AMD - Bruno: MI300 driver regression found in pre-ship tests; fix ETA tomorrow night. If that slips we push enablement by 1 week. No NDA changes.
Infra - Zoe: Practical constraints: we must validate drivers + regen Gaudi kernels. Current stack snapshot:
```
base-image: rwd-22.04-gpu:v2.0
kernel: 5.19.90
cuda: 12.2
rocm: 5.8
model-optimizer: 3.1.0
```
Infra - Zoe: Kernel regen for Gaudi adds ~24h; full cross-region canary ~36h. We can parallelize region tests but need traffic shaping for SI integrations.
Comms - Marcus: Prefer single-week announce. But we need approved partner quotes and a fallback asset that omits concrete ship dates. Can we produce that?
Legal - Priyanka: Yes — prepare "soft-window" and "firm-date" variants. We need partner signoff on either and request 24h for legal review of partner-provided quotes.
Lena P: Proposed cadence:
- Day 0: partner pre-brief (48h before public)
- Day 1: infra kernel regen + start regional canaries (limited customers)
- Day 3: partner & legal signoff on copy + assets
- Day 4: conditional publish (blocked until canary green)
NVIDIA - Mei: Fine. Marketing wants perf asterisks: call them "preliminary results".
AMD - Bruno: If our fix pushes past Day 1 we need to slip publish by one week.
Arjun S: SI note: integrators asked for a 2-week post-announce onboarding window for validation in enterprise accounts. Should we coordinate separate GA for SI customers?
Comms - Marcus: Good call. Suggest public marketplace announce first, then an SI-specific enablement email 2w later once partner images are distributed. Keeps press simple.
Infra - Zoe: Spun up 4-node canary (2 NA, 1 EU, 1 APAC) with limited traffic. Telemetry prefix: s3://redwood/partner-canaries/3609876543/.
ci-bot: Canary job started: canary-3609876543 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3609876543/logs
Infra - Zoe: Early kernel regen done for Gaudi; no segfaults. Running perf baselines now.
ci-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, artifacts -> s3://redwood/partner-canaries/3609876543/artifacts.tgz
Arjun S: Canary PASS. Minor thermal delta on B200 in APAC test (+2.6%) but within safe margin. Noting in release notes.
Comms - Marcus: Drafting two asset sets now (soft-window + firm). Will include SI timeline separate doc.
Legal - Priyanka: I'll join partner approval loop. Expect 24h review.
NVIDIA - Mei: We'll review the soft copy today. Please call out inventory constraints per region.
AMD - Bruno: Confirming driver patch shipping tonight; will update if any regression remains.
Lena P: Decision: we proceed with a single public announce using the soft-window copy, prebrief partners 48h before publish, and plan SI-specific GA two weeks after marketplace publish. If any of the canaries or partner approvals fail, we hold.
Comms - Marcus: Noted. I'll set the press queue as "tentative" and schedule comms tasks.
Arjun S: Action items: Zoe upload full canary metrics to the S3 prefix; Marcus circulate assets; Priyanka on legal loop; Lena to run partner handoff call tomorrow 9am PT.
Infra - Zoe: Uploaded metrics: https://s3.console.aws.redwood/partner-canaries/3609876543/metrics.json
ci-bot: Reminder scheduled: partner-handoff-call @ 2026-03-24T09:00:00-07:00
Lena P: Thanks all. Quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
NVIDIA - Mei: :thumbsup:
AMD - Bruno: :thumbsup:
Comms - Marcus: :thumbsup:
Legal - Priyanka: :thumbsup:
Arjun S: :thumbsup:
